summary: Portal features come from Ansible Backstage Plugins on an uncustomized Developer Hub image: auth-backend-module-rhaap-provider (OAuth 2.0 with AAP), catalog-backend-module-rhaap (syncs job templates as software templates), scaffolder-backend-module-backstage-rhaap (rhaap:launch-job-template), backstage-rhaap-common (shared libraries) and self-service (UI).
questions: Which Backstage plugins make up self-service automation portal?
Which plugin syncs AAP job templates into Backstage?
Which plugin provides the rhaap:launch-job-template action?
How does self-service automation portal authenticate with AAP?

answer_card.title: Ansible Backstage Plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
| Plugin | Function |
|---|---|
| `auth-backend-module-rhaap-provider` | OAuth 2.0 authentication with AAP |
| `catalog-backend-module-rhaap` | Syncs AAP job templates as Backstage Software Templates |
| `scaffolder-backend-module-backstage-rhaap` | Provides `rhaap:launch-job-template` |
| `backstage-rhaap-common` | Shared libraries and utilities |
| `self-service` | The user interface |
